description: 5dive dashboard plugin lifecycle hooks — on a usage-limit or transient-API StopFailure, post one notice into the web chat the person wrote in, and (on a seat without the telegram plugin) resume and answer once the limit lifts; bridge AskUserQuestion to tap buttons in the web chat; label each step so the chat shows what the agent is working on; and relay a reply the agent wrote in its session without calling the reply tool.
